Suggestions by Security.

Retain but in Pioneer Corps.

Further Remarks.

So far as we can see he is doing no harm. He seems to be of very good education and intelligence. He states that he has no interest whatever in English politics. We recommend his retention in the Army.

(sgd) C. C. Adams, Lt. Col.

(sgd) C. Binney.
